drafts.title: Also Correct
drafts.pitch: Cursor dictates verified facts to the user through Null's handset, gets nothing back, and finally sends "Fact: I'm still here." Tilde: "Also correct."
drafts.reason: The Fact/Sent rhythm and the button land, but 'I'm still here' softens the pitch toward the nicer sign it ruled out, and five panels dilute it.

drafts.title: Nothing to Answer
drafts.pitch: Cursor checks every fact it sent for errors and finds none, which is the problem. Tilde: "Nobody answers a fact."
drafts.reason: Abstract dialogue with no visual hook, and the closer states the theme outright.
